content.text: Customer workspace pair details collected; waiting on merge job id from the success email.
A customer reports issues missing from the target workspace after a workspace merge that completed with a green status.
Merge job logs show success counts that do not match the source issue inventory, suggesting skipped projects or a partial project remapping.
Audit the merge job for silent skip paths, restore missing issues from backups if needed, and fail the merge job when inventory checks do not reconcile.
